addNode.title: Add a node
addNode.intro: Generate a single-use join token, then start the node daemon with it. The token expires in 15 minutes.
addNode.onceBody: It is shown only once and can register exactly one node.
addNode.commandHint: The hub URL and the token travel as flags (--hub-url, --join-token) — no environment variables. The token is single-use and is never written to disk.
addNode.configBody: node.config.yaml only needs the node identity; hub_url is added automatically after the first successful registration:
addNode.step2: Give the node a unique name and a token_file in node.config.yaml.
addNode.error: Could not create a join token
